# Techfusion Automata (Pty) Ltd

> Techfusion Automata (Pty) Ltd is a South African digital transformation, deterministic artificial intelligence, data engineering, and bespoke software consultancy (B-BBEE Level 1 EME — 135% Procurement Recognition, 100% Black-Owned). We modernize institutional infrastructure and deploy automated, POPIA Section 71 and ISO/IEC 42001-aligned systems for public-sector departments, international development agencies (UN/NGOs), and private enterprises across Africa.

## Entity & Procurement Summary
- **Legal Name:** Techfusion Automata (Pty) Ltd
- **Jurisdiction:** Republic of South Africa (CIPC Registered Private Company)
- **B-BBEE Status:** Level 1 Contributor (135% Procurement Recognition, 100% Black-Owned EME)
- **Tax & CSD Standing:** SARS Tax Compliant & Central Supplier Database (CSD) Registered (verification PINs dispatched via private SCM desk)
- **Commercial AI Division:** [TechFusion Alchemy](https://techfusion-alchemy.xyz)
- **Primary Website:** https://techfusion-ventures.xyz
- **Full Technical & Procurement Reference:** https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/llms-full.txt

## Accredited OEM Partner Ecosystem
1. **Microsoft** — Microsoft Partner Network (Verified Partner)
2. **OpenAI** — OpenAI Partner Network (Approved Member)
3. **Google Cloud** — Partner Advantage (Approved Member)
4. **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** — AWS Partner Network / APN (Registered Partner)
5. **DigiCert** — PKI & Certificate Lifecycle (Approved Member)

## Six Core Service Pillars
1. **Pillar 01: Digital Transformation** — End-to-end business process digitization, workflow re-engineering, SOP automation, and legacy institutional system modernization.
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=digital-transformation
2. **Pillar 02: Automation & Intelligent AI Systems** — Business/Robotic Process Automation (BPA/RPA), agentic multi-agent orchestration (MCP), Intelligent Document Processing (IDP/OCR), conversational AI, and executive decision-support platforms.
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=automation-ai
   - Commercial Division: https://techfusion-alchemy.xyz
3. **Pillar 03: Data Engineering & Advanced Analytics** — Enterprise data warehouse design, real-time and batch ETL/ELT pipelines, BI executive dashboards, and POPIA-compliant data governance.
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=data-engineering
4. **Pillar 04: Custom Software Development** — Cloud-native web and mobile applications (React, Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node.js), high-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs, and secure citizen or enterprise client portals.
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=custom-software
5. **Pillar 05: Cloud & Systems Integration** — Microsoft 365 & Power Platform ecosystems, PostgreSQL and Supabase backends, ERP/CRM webhook integrations, and Identity & Access Management (IAM).
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=cloud-integration
6. **Pillar 06: Government & Public-Sector Solutions** — Management Information Systems (MIS), case/grant/complaint management systems, Electronic Document & Records Management Systems (EDRMS), and Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) platforms for UN/NGO programs.
   - Direct Inquiry: https://techfusion-ventures.xyz/contact?service=government-solutions

## Governance, Security & Statutory Compliance
- **AI Governance:** ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS) Charter & NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) alignment with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) controls.
- **Information Security:** ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (ISMS) Statement of Applicability & ISO/IEC 27701 / SOC 2 Type II roadmap.
- **Data Privacy & Algorithmic Rights:** POPIA Section 71 automated decision-making safeguards & PAIA Section 51 Manual.
- **Ethics & Statutory Integrity:** King IV Corporate Governance, PRECCA / FICA / POCA Anti-Fraud & Anti-Bribery programme, and ISO 9001–aligned Quality Policy.
